headline: Commission approved certificates of compliance, tree removals, and orders of conditions while continuing several hearings to August 18, 2026
summary: The Commission handled routine matters including a certificate of compliance, tree removal requests, and an emergency culvert repair ratification. It closed hearings and issued Orders of Conditions for projects at 40 Prince Street and 200 Lothrop Street, continued several other hearings to August 18, 2026 for further review or site walks, issued determinations of applicability for tree removal and a jurisdiction question, and addressed enforcement order matters at three properties.
decisions: Issued a Complete Certificate of Compliance for 90 Boyles Street, DEP File #5-1458, including perpetual conditions #37-40, 4-0.
Approved the tree removal request for 181 Lothrop Street with standard conditions, 4-0.
Approved the tree removal request for 27 South Terrace with standard conditions, 4-0.
Continued the 28 Whitehall Circle tree removal item to the August 18, 2026 meeting, 4-0.
Ratified the Emergency Certification for a culvert repair at 1 Brookwood Road, 4-0.
Continued the hearing for 58 West Street, DEP File #5-1472, to August 18, 2026, 4-0.
Closed the hearing for 40 Prince Street, DEP File #5-1474, 3-0.
Closed the hearing for 200 Lothrop Street, DEP File #5-1475, 4-0.
Continued the hearing for 343 Dodge Street, DEP File #5-1476, to August 18, 2026, 4-0.
Continued the hearing for 31 Haskell Street to August 18, 2026, 4-0.
Continued the hearing for 11 & 13 Bay View Avenue to August 18, 2026, 4-0.
Continued the hearing for 22 Kittredge Street to August 18, 2026, 4-0.
Issued a Negative 3 Determination of Applicability with conditions for 100 Pond View Lane, 4-0.
Issued a Negative 1 & 6 Determination of Applicability for 37 Enon Street, 3-0-1 (Squibb abstained).
Lifted the Enforcement Order for 12 Museum Road, 4-0.
Amended the Enforcement Order for 25 Linden Avenue requiring continued monitoring and documentation by September 30, 2026, 4-0.
Left the Enforcement Order for 11 & 13 Bay View Avenue open with no vote taken.
Approved payment of MSMCP membership dues of $50, 4-0.
Approved payment of Conservation Agent June mileage of $26.53 and Conservation Field Inspector June mileage of $11.12, 4-0.
Issued an Order of Conditions for 40 Prince Street, DEP File #5-1474, with special conditions, 3-0.
Issued an Order of Conditions for 200 Lothrop Street, DEP File #5-1475, with special conditions, 4-0.
Approved the meeting minutes of June 30, 2026, as presented, 3-0-1 (Miller abstained).
